questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to replace the * signs and to balance the given equation.

52 * 4 * 38 * 5 * 5 * 0
questions.solution:
Given equation: 52 * 4 * 38 * 5 * 5 * 0.

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) ×, ×, +, =, ×

Given: 52 * 4 * 38 * 5 * 5 * 0

After replacing the * signs we get;

⇒ __**52 × 4 × 38**__ + 5 = __**5 × 0**__

⇒ __**7904 + 5**__ = 0

⇒ 7909 ≠ 0

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

**Option 2) ÷, =, −, ×, +**

Given: 52 * 4 * 38 * 5 * 5 * 0

After replacing the * signs we get;

⇒ __**52 ÷ 4**__ = 38 - __**5 × 5**__ + 0

⇒ 13 = __**38 - 25 + 0**__

⇒ **13 = 13**

**⇒ LHS = RHS**

Option 3) ×, +, ÷, =, −

Given: 52 * 4 * 38 * 5 * 5 * 0

After replacing the * signs we get;

⇒ 52 × 4 + __**38 ÷ 5**__ = __**5 - 0**__

⇒ __**52 × 4**__ + 7.6 = 5 

⇒ __**208 + 7.6**__ = 5 

⇒ 215.6 ≠ 5 

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) ÷, =, −, ÷, ×

Given: 52 * 4 * 38 * 5 * 5 * 0

After replacing the * signs we get;

⇒ __**52 ÷ 4**__ = 38 - __**5 ÷ 5**__ × 0

⇒ 13 = 38 - __**1 × 0**__

⇒ 13 = __**38 - **____0__

⇒ 13 ≠ 38

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'MAY’ is coded as '6' and 'MET' is coded as '7'. How will 'HIM' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0270f2b5240d1e3915517248ac98d6d73ad611166857551401277421991a6c6e.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic:** Digit Sum of Sum of the opposite place value of the letters**.

Now,

‘MAY’ is coded as '6’

Opposite of MAY is NZB

⇒ N(14) + Z(26) + B(2)

⇒ (14 + 26 + 2) 

⇒ 42 → 4 + 2 = 6.

For, ‘MET' is coded as '7’

Opposite of MET is NVG

⇒ N(14) + V(22) + G(7)

⇒ (14 + 22 + 7) 

⇒ 43 → 4 + 3 = 7.

Similarly, for ‘HIM’

**Opposite of HIM is SRN**

**⇒ S(19) + R(18) + N(14)**

**⇒ (19 + 18 + 14) **

**⇒ 51 → 5 + 1 = 6.**

So, 'HIM' will be coded as '6'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All dates are cashews.

All cashews are raisins.

Some raisins are almonds.

**Conclusions:**

I. All almonds being dates is a possibility.

II. All dates are raisins.

III. No cashew is an almond.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

All dates are cashews.

All cashews are raisins.

Some raisins are almonds.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a17eb5289a3b9d4824b1be2dbfc14c625e2a468a19d3cc9f667938bb1cb93fb8.png] 

Conclusion:

I. All almonds being dates is a possibility - True (No definite relation given between almonds and dates, so it can be possible).

II. All dates are raisins - **True **(All dates are cashews and All cashews are raisins, so All dates are raisins).

III. No cashew is an almond - False (No definite relation given between cashew and almond, so it can be possible only)

So, Only conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the numbers of the given sets. (NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.) 

(12, 9, 4)

(18, 9, 6)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (√2nd number** ****× 3rd number)** = 1st number.

Now,

For, (12, 9, 4)

⇒ (√9 × 4)

⇒ 3 × 4 = 12.

For, (18, 9, 6)

⇒ (√9 × 6)

⇒ 3 × 6 = 18.

Similarly, for **(12, 16, 3)**

**⇒ (√16 × 3)**

**⇒ 4 × 3 = 12.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Three Statements are given followed by Four conclusions numbered I, II, III and IV. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some curtains are pillows.

No pillow is a bedsheet.

Some curtains are bedsheets.

**Conclusions:**

I. No curtain is a bedsheet.

II. No pillow is a curtain.

III. Some bedsheets are curtains.

IV. Some pillows are curtains.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions III and IV follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some curtains are pillows.

No pillow is a bedsheet.

Some curtains are bedsheets.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/907fafd08bd0aedce06a4c952598de4f748f093f975e27a890071ade9ec2039f.png] 

Conclusion:

I. No curtain is a bedsheet - False (Because, Some curtains are bedsheets).

II. No pillow is a curtain - False (Because, Some curtains are pillows).

III. Some bedsheets are curtains - True (Because, Some curtains are bedsheets).

IV. Some pillows are curtains - True (Because, Some curtains are pillows).

So, Both conclusions III and IV follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
